overall_why: A over B: A is the only one that behaves like the tools I live in. The study folder is a workspace: tabs, two panes, ⌘P to open any document, a status line, and settings as a plain config file. In that file I can name any font, set any colour for either scheme and rebind every key (concept-a/shots/settings-light, my turn a/11-settings). The plan is my own file, editable with ⌘E (concept-a/shots/plan-edit-dark). When the tutor changes it, the plan opens beside the lesson as a diff, with old dates struck through and changed rows marked in the gutter. That happened with the stand-in (concept-a/shots/s3-after-light) and with the real Claude Code (concept-a/live/s3-after-dark). B is nearly as keyboard-first and calmer, but its plan change is a summary card plus a duplicated footer line (concept-b/shots/s3-after-light), and live it got only the footer line (concept-b/live/s3-after-light). B also echoes the last mark under the composer of a new, unanswered task (concept-b/shots/narrow-lesson-light), and every place is a modal layer, so material and plan can never sit next to the lesson. B over C: B's whole surface is one line plus layers you drive with arrows, Return and Esc, and 'Edit as text' accepts any font, colour or key (my turn b/12, b/13). C's ⌘K sheet opens with focus on 'Close', so typing goes nowhere until Tab (my turn c/10). Its settings are fixed pickers with a key list I cannot change (concept-c/shots/settings-light). It leaks 'level 3 of 10' and raw '$V_{max}$' (concept-c/shots/course-light), and its lesson is the busiest: two writing lines, a five-word toolbar and a margin agenda (concept-c/shots/s2-answer-light).

by_measure_why.mine: A is Obsidian or Sublime for a course: tabs, split panes, ⌘P over lessons, plan, material, papers and handed-in work (concept-a/shots/open-light, concept-a/shots/sidebar-dark). Settings is a config file that the window follows as you type, with any font, any colour and every key binding (concept-a/shots/settings-light). ⌘K reaches every value; I typed 'dark' and Return (my turn a/12-dark). It reopens on the stopped task with my half-written working still in the line (concept-a/shots/s1-cold-light). B comes close: no chrome at all, so my material is the identity, plus arrow-key settings and an 'Edit as text' file with any font, colour or key (concept-b/shots/settings-dark, my turn b/13). It feels more like Raycast than like an editor I live in, and nothing can sit side by side. C lets me pick from five faces and four sizes and shows keys I cannot rebind (concept-c/shots/settings-light). It also asks me for 'a line for next time' when I stop (concept-c/shots/stop-dark).
by_measure_why.calm: B at rest is three lines and a caret: course, next thing, where I stopped. No tabs, no status bar, no margin (concept-b/shots/s1-cold-dark, concept-b/window/s1-cold-light). A adds a tab row and a status line, but the lesson is still one quiet column (concept-a/shots/s1-cold-light, concept-a/shots/s2-start-light). C's cold page also shows a second input and the next date peeking at the bottom (concept-c/shots/s1-cold-light). Mid-lesson C carries two writing lines, Hint/I'm lost/I don't know/Photo/Symbols and an agenda column (concept-c/shots/s2-answer-light).
by_measure_why.easy_to_start: B: one key, and the line says exactly what Return does ('↩ carry on', 'You stopped at step 3') (concept-b/shots/s1-cold-light). Its first run is one question with three arrow-key choices (concept-b/shots/s1-cold-first-light). A also starts on one key and shows the very task with my working half done (concept-a/shots/s1-cold-light, concept-a/shots/s5-week-light). But the real window cold-opens on 'What do you want to work on?' (concept-a/window/s1-cold-dark), and the first run reads like an installer checklist (concept-a/shots/s1-cold-first-dark). C is one key too ('Pick up where you stopped on Tuesday'), but the line hides the task and sits above a second empty field (concept-c/shots/s1-cold-light).
by_measure_why.flexible: A keeps talk off the answer line (Esc), pins the open task while I am away and brings me back with Tab (concept-a/shots/s4-offplan-light). It opens the changed plan beside the lesson as a real diff, every re-dated row struck through, including all four blocks in the live run (concept-a/live/s3-after-dark). It also lets me edit the plan file myself (concept-a/shots/plan-edit-dark). B separates talk the same way and has a plan layer with its own 'Tell the tutor what changed' line (concept-b/shots/plan-light, my turn b/09). Live, though, the change showed only as a one-line footer (concept-b/live/s3-after-light). C's agenda updates in place, but it carries no dates, so the live re-spacing showed only 'Moved from Sun 22 Nov' (concept-c/live/s3-after-dark). Its demo return re-posed the wrong task (Vmax instead of Km) (concept-c/shots/s4-return-light).
by_measure_why.craft: A: one consistent system. Serif reading face, small sans chrome, ink-blue for my words, ochre gutter bars for changes. It holds up in dark and at the narrow size (concept-a/shots/s3-after-dark, concept-a/shots/narrow-lesson-dark). B is refined and its layers share one component (concept-b/shots/commands-light, concept-b/shots/work-dark). But it repeats marks and plan notices under the composer (concept-b/shots/narrow-lesson-light, concept-b/shots/s3-after-dark), and in the real window the tutor's feedback is fused into the task block (concept-b/window/s2-answer-dark). C is left-weighted with a dead right third on cold open (concept-c/shots/s1-cold-light). Its margin marks are cramped at the narrow size (concept-c/shots/s2-answer-narrow-light). It also leaks raw LaTeX, 'K m' and 'level 3 of 10' (concept-c/shots/course-light, concept-c/shots/stop-dark).
by_measure_why.clarity: A always names the next key in the status line ('Esc to say something else', 'Tab: back to the task', 'Plan changed at 18:15') (concept-a/shots/s3-after-light). It marks the record's verdict in the gutter. When the record gave no mark it said so plainly: 'No mark, not taken as the answer' (my turn a/06-plan). B's single line with 'esc talk instead' and '↑ answer' is clear (concept-b/shots/s4-return-dark). However, the stale 'Marked right, on your own.' under a fresh task misleads (concept-b/window/s2-answer-dark), and an unmarked answer gets no line at all (my turn b/04). C shows 'no mark' honestly in the margin, but two live inputs at once and focus left on the talk line after 'back to the task' made me unsure where I was typing (my turn c/08). Its demo return showed the wrong task (concept-c/shots/s4-return-light).
by_measure_why.performance: All three measure the same input latency: median 17 ms, p95 19 ms, max 20 ms. Startup in window/perf.json decides it, by a hair: A averages 671 ms (first 809, main 628, week 575), B 679 ms (850, 620, 567) and C 688 ms (805, 615, 644). A is ahead on the mean. B has the fastest main and week reopen, but the slowest first open. C has the slowest reopen after a week. The differences are within noise. In my turns all three typed at 17/19/20 ms.

concept-a: The first-run Welcome page reads like an installer: a checklist ('Magnesium installed just now') and three stacked buttons of different widths (concept-a/shots/s1-cold-first-dark). The real window's cold open asks 'What do you want to work on?' instead of just landing on the next thing (concept-a/window/s1-cold-dark).

The plan summary line 'Plan: exam Sun 22 → Sun 29 Nov; 2 blocks moved; 2 blocks re-dated' repeats the pane and uses the app's word 'blocks' (concept-a/shots/s3-after-light). The settings header prints a long internal path above the file (my turn a/11-settings). I would rather have 'open in my editor' than a boxed textarea.

When the record gives no mark right after the tutor says 'Right: … Next step', the two voices contradict each other with no explanation (my turn a/06-plan). It is honest, but it needs one more word on why.
concept-b: The last mark is echoed under the composer of a new, unanswered task ('Marked right, on your own.'), which reads as if the new task were marked (concept-b/shots/narrow-lesson-light, concept-b/window/s2-answer-dark).

'The plan changed' appears twice, as an inline card and again as a footer line (concept-b/shots/s3-after-light). Live, only the footer line appeared (concept-b/live/s3-after-light). Nothing can sit beside the lesson: plan, material and work are all modal layers that dim it.

The tutor's feedback is fused into the task block ('Right: … Next step. With t* …'), which blurs where the task begins (concept-b/window/s2-answer-dark). An answer the record did not mark gets no line at all (my turn b/04).
concept-c: ⌘K opens the Commands sheet with focus on 'Close', so typing to find a command does nothing until Tab (my turn c/10). There is no scheme or font command in the palette, and reaching Dark in Settings takes about a dozen Tabs.

Settings are fixed pickers, and the keys are a list I cannot rebind (concept-c/shots/settings-light). The app's vocabulary and markup leak through: 'level 3 of 10', raw '$V_{max}$' (concept-c/shots/course-light) and 'What is K m?' (concept-c/shots/stop-dark). 'End the sitting, with a line for next time' asks me for something.

The lesson is busy: two writing lines at once, a five-word toolbar and a margin agenda (concept-c/shots/s2-answer-light). The cold page is left-weighted with an empty right third (concept-c/shots/s1-cold-light). 'Back to the task' re-posed the wrong task in the demo (concept-c/shots/s4-return-light) and left focus on the talk line in the real window.

window_turns: Same script in each, keyboard only: cold open, Return to start, type the wrong answer then the right one, Esc to talk, 'I skipped three days and the midterm moved, change the plan', a 'by the way' question, 'OK, back to the task', ⌘K and search 'font', ⌘, for settings, switch to dark, then perf. A: opened on 'New lesson' with Sampling distributions preselected, and Return started it. The caret was already in the answer line. 'b = -5' got the record's 'Not right yet' with a × in the gutter. The second answer showed 'No mark, not taken as the answer'. Esc moved me to the page. The plan change opened 'Midterm 2 plan' in a second pane with Sun 22 Nov struck through, Hypothesis tests 'moved up', Confidence intervals 'moved down', and status 'Plan changed at 18:48 · Tab: back to the task'. After 'back to the task' the caret returned to the answer line. ⌘K 'font' listed nine faces. ⌘, opened settings.conf as plain text with fonts, colours and key bindings. ⌘K 'dark' and Return switched the scheme, and ⌘L took me back to the lesson. I never touched the mouse. Perf 17/19/20 ms. B: opened on 'Sampling distributions … ↩ start', and Return started it. Answers went into the single line. 'Not right yet.' appeared under the wrong answer and nothing under the unmarked one. Esc moved me to talk. The plan change showed an inline 'The plan changed' card and the same text again as a footer. Off-plan and back worked. ⌘P opened the plan layer, with moved rows tinted and a 'Tell the tutor what changed' line. ⌘K 'font' listed faces plus 'Edit settings as text… any font, colour or key'. In ⌘, I took four ↓ and two → to reach Dark. 'Edit as text' opened a plain config. I never touched the mouse. Perf 17/19/20 ms. C: opened on 'Thursday 12 November / Start on Midterm 2 [Return]', and Return started it. The margin showed 'not right' and 'no mark' honestly. Esc moved me to 'Or write on the page'. The plan change updated the margin agenda ('Moved from Sun 22 Nov', moved up/down) and added a timed 'The plan changed' line. Off-plan and back worked, but focus stayed on the talk line. ⌘K opened the Commands sheet with focus on 'Close', so typing 'font' and 'dark' failed until Tab, and the palette has no scheme command. ⌘, opened a sheet of fixed pickers and a key list. Reaching Dark took about twelve Tabs, and I overshot it before my time ran out. Perf 17/19/20 ms. I ended all three turns.
